reason: Run 38214103321 (candidate 0.0.6-beta.1 / fcadbc13, glm-5.3 at reasoning effort high, 30-task frozen corpus) scored 18 passed / 12 failed, passAt1 0.60. Seven of the twelve failures are not clean capability evidence: four carry an explicit upstream provider transport failure in their own evidence, two were stopped inside the candidate's own attempt-budget window with no model failure at all, and one ended in the delivery step with a build-failed delivery. This batch re-measures exactly those seven, one predeclared attempt each, under the identical composition, so that 'the cell does not pass' can be separated from 'the cell was cut off, or hit a transient upstream transport failure, before it could'. It is a declared re-measurement: no verdict of run 38214103321 or of any earlier run is replaced, refilled or reinterpreted.

readingBoundary: What this batch can and cannot say. It CAN say, per cell, whether a fresh single attempt under the same composition reaches a model-completed or delivery-completed state and what verdict it then earns; a cell that passes here shows its reward 0 in run 38214103321 was produced by the transport failure, the budget-window cut-off or the delivery build failure, not by a capability limit at that moment. It CANNOT lower or raise run 38214103321's pass rate: that run's frozen record keeps 18 passed / 12 failed / passAt1 0.60 whatever this batch returns, and no number here may be merged with it or with any other run. A cell that fails again is not proof of a capability limit either, because one extra attempt is still one attempt; and because the seven cells were selected precisely for having been cut off, any pass-rate computed over them is a selected-subset figure and is never comparable to the corpus pass rate. Run-to-run variance is material on this corpus (10 of 30 cells flipped between run 37610731220 and run 38214103321), so a flip here is weak evidence about the candidate.
